{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], divided
* 1 tbsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]], divided
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] crumbled [[Cookbook:Cornbread (disambiguation)|cornbread]]
* ¼ cup dried [[Cookbook:Cranberry|cranberries]], roughly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* ½ cup apple jelly
* 3 dried [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]] rings, finely [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Honey|Honey]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper, cornbread, fruit, jelly, and cheese. Pour into a gallon (4 liter) size zip-top bag with a very small hole snipped in one of the bottom corners.
#Using a narrow boning knife, make a slit in one of the chicken breast's side, but not all the way through. Repeat until all chicken has been cut.
#Fill the slits ⅔ of the way full with the cornbread mixture. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the edges with honey and press together to seal. Tie closed with kitchen twine.
#Place the chicken in a large roasting pan. Brush with olive oil and season each piece liberally with remaining salt and pepper.
#Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] in one of the pieces, but not touching stuffing. Place pan in the center of a 400°F (205°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] and cook until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C)
#Remove to a plate and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 7 minutes before removing thermometer and untying. Serve warm.
